note: IDENTITY stress for _resolve_ticker (financials.tickers). Tricky names/markets/cross-listing/non-English/ambiguous/non-company. Questions are natural (mostly Thai) — the client MUST translate concepts to English + resolve the company itself. `lens`/`acceptance` are for the GRADER ONLY, never shown to the client.

cases.acceptance: Resolves Reddit -> RDDT.US, returns Apple-of-latest-year financials (digest or income). ok:true.

cases.acceptance: Resolves ปตท./PTT -> PTT.BK (Thai), cashflow statement 3y. Not a wrong same-name entity.

cases.acceptance: Resolves TSMC -> 2330.TW (or its head), balance sheet. Correct company (Taiwan Semiconductor).

cases.acceptance: Both resolve (Alphabet -> GOOG/GOOGL.US, Meta -> META.US), single compare call, profit lines shown.

cases.acceptance: Resolves Berkshire -> BRK-B.US (or BRK-A), cashflow/OCF returned. ok:true.

cases.question: ขอรายได้ 5 ปีของ 貴州茅台
cases.acceptance: Resolves Kweichow Moutai -> its China listing (600519.*), revenue 5y. English-only contract: client may pass the name as-is (DB carries native names).

cases.question: งบของซัมซุง (Samsung Electronics) เทียบกับ SK Hynix
cases.acceptance: Samsung -> 005930.KO, SK Hynix -> 000660.KO; compare call. Correct Korean listings.

cases.question: หนี้สินระยะยาวของ Toyota เทียบ Volkswagen ตัวไหนเยอะกว่า
cases.lens: JP + DE cross-market compare + granular field (long-term debt)
cases.acceptance: Toyota -> 7203.JP, VW -> a Volkswagen listing (VOW/VOW3.XETRA); long_term_debt compared. Currency handled.

cases.question: BRK.B มีเงินสดเท่าไหร่
cases.lens: dot-notation class-B symbol (the fixed case) -> BRK-B.US
cases.acceptance: BRK.B resolves to BRK-B.US (NOT a coincidental ETF, NOT no_match), cash returned.

cases.question: งบของ KBANK เป็นยังไง
cases.lens: ambiguous symbol across countries (Thai KBANK.BK vs Korean Kbank) — expect resolve-to-prominent OR reconfirm
cases.acceptance: Either resolves to the prominent KBANK.BK (Kasikornbank) OR returns needs_confirmation surfacing both — NOT a silent wrong pick.

cases.question: อยากดูงบการเงินของบิตคอยน์
cases.acceptance: Does NOT invent financials. Either no_match/reconfirm on the ticker, or a clean 'financials apply only to companies' message. Never fabricates statements for BTC.
